'''Patrol lighters''' were a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used by the military forces of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Freda]]. Several patrol lighters destroyed a [[Jante]] mining camp in the [[Rettna system/Legends|Rettna system]].
